name: flowboard-triage
description: Review a Solidity finding with source cards and evidence notes in Solidity Flowboard.

flowboardTriage.engagementProfile.description: Optional workspace-relative JSON engagement mapping (version 1: name, revision, labels, eligibleBands). Empty means reportability not assessed. Uses General Audit v1 reviewed factors; changing labels never starts a model request or changes your decision. Material trust/behavior assumptions require a finding correction. See docs/GUIDED-READING.md.

flowboardTriage.semanticProvider.description: Opt in to background source-only review of every finding in the imported report. Sends report sections and bounded code excerpts to your configured CLI account under a shared report request limit. Claude has a per-pass USD cap; Codex has a timeout, not a USD cap. Tools/hooks/apps are disabled. 'none' keeps offline code/report exploration usable.

flowboardTriage.codexPath.description: Absolute Codex CLI path without arguments. Empty uses codex on PATH. Requires authenticated CLI supporting ignore-user-config, ephemeral and structured output. Only direct, non-daemonizing CLIs are supported; wrappers that detach workers from the owned process group are unsupported.

flowboardTriage.codexModel.description: Explicit Codex model identifier. Empty preserves the CLI default with user configuration ignored. Account availability is not proved locally; a rejection never silently downgrades. Does not regenerate saved findings or increase shared concurrency.

flowboardTriage.codexReasoningEffort.description: Requested Codex reasoning effort. The installed CLI flags are checked locally; support depends on the chosen model/account and is not guaranteed. Existing in-flight requests keep their captured settings.

flowboardTriage.claudePath.description: Absolute Claude CLI executable path, without arguments. Empty uses claude on PATH. Requires an authenticated non-daemonizing CLI with safe-mode support. Wrappers detaching workers from the owned process group are unsupported.

flowboardTriage.semanticBudgetUSD.description: Maximum Claude budget per request. Each preparation uses generation, challenge, at most one response repair and two new-code checks, subject to the shared report request limit. Resume retains accepted stages.

flowboardTriage.reportRequestLimit.description: NEW reports: 0 derives a finite maximum from unfinished finding plans; a positive value is an explicit shared cap. Existing ledgers are never replenished by changing this default. Counts durably reserved attempts, including later spawn failure, not tokens, concurrency or money. Expected demand is usually two requests per cold finding; maximum includes bounded repairs. Unknown cost is not zero. Explicit Resume adds the configured allowance.

flowboardTriage.preparationWorkers.description: Concurrent source-review stages for this report. Does not increase any request or spending allowance. A shared local provider limit also applies.

flowboardTriage.findingRequestLimit.description: Maximum reserved attempts per new finding: generation, mandatory challenge, one response repair total, up to two new-code follow-ups and bounded transport recovery. Stage yields/reloads retain counters. Does not enlarge an existing shared report allowance.

flowboardTriage.providerConcurrency.description: Configured shared local capacity per OS user/provider across projects, not discovered remote account quota or cross-machine coordination. Conflicting active capacity settings are refused; change when the shared pool is idle. Configure only supported host/account capacity. Does not grant request or monetary allowance.

flowboardTriage.reportTimeLimitMinutes.description: Optional explicit time limit for NEW report runs, from import acceptance. Default 0: observe elapsed time without stopping quality review. Positive selection stops owned work at its chosen boundary, preserving paid responses and guides. Historical reportDeadlineMinutes/default deadlines do not authorize a stop. Per-request timeouts and request caps still apply.

flowboardTriage.analysisMode.description: Source mode needs no compiler. Slither mode also runs the local project build; source navigation is heuristic in either mode.

flowboardTriage.slitherPath.description: Absolute path to a Slither executable. Otherwise use the project's isolated .flowboard/tools/slither-venv, then PATH. No shell arguments.
